suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-14 adds this relationship only as the user-approved bounded clinical proposition. A large propensity-matched cohort found substantially increased incident deep-vein thrombosis after varicose-vein diagnosis; the approved relationship is limited to temporal association/risk because causality versus shared risk factors remains unresolved. Require varicose veins preceding a newly established deep-vein thrombosis and exclude preexisting deep-vein thrombosis. Explicitly assess recent venous surgery or endovenous procedures, prior venous thromboembolism, thrombophilia, malignancy, immobilization, pregnancy or estrogen exposure, trauma or surgery, age, obesity, and other thrombotic risks. Do not publish or present this relationship as proof that varicose veins caused the deep-vein thrombosis. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
